visualizerParams.title: Code Refactor: Operators Instead of Named Methods
visualizerParams.problemDescription: The class has add and text methods, which callers must know about. Use __add__ and __str__ so that a + b and print work. The output must stay the same.

solution.explanation: With special methods the object behaves like a built-in type: a + b reads naturally, and print(a) works without calling a method by name.
